title: HW↔BACK-001: Hardware Identity Anchors + Backend Provisioning Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the Hardware Engineer or the Backend/Cloud Engineer side (HARDWARE_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Backend; BACKEND_CLOUD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Hardware Engineer). The relationship is mediated and security-relevant: the hardware root of trust / secure element is governed by HW↔SEC-001, the cloud PKI / X.509 device identity by BACK↔SEC-001, and production provisioning/enrollment by HW↔DEVOPS-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (hardware identity anchors ↔ backend provisioning requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER, and any device-identity touchpoint fires ESC-SEC.

hardware_identity_anchors.description: HW→BACK: hardware roots for device identity (security-governed).

security_touchpoint.description: True when the requirement touches cryptographic device identity — fires ESC-SEC.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; the relationship is mediated and security-relevant. Routine non-security provisioning coordination is provisional and must COUNTER for ratification; any cryptographic-device-identity touchpoint fires ESC-SEC and is bound under HW↔SEC-001 / BACK↔SEC-001.

mediation.rationale: No direct contract needed: this edge is security-baseline territory — cryptographic device identity is SEC-owned (HW↔SEC-001 / BACK↔SEC-001) and provisioning/enrollment via HW↔DEVOPS-001; a direct HW↔BACK contract would be a security anti-pattern (ESC-SEC, HG-01).

x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: device-identity touchpoints carry a Security review reference (HW↔SEC-001 / BACK↔SEC-001)
the provisioning/enrollment path defers to HW↔DEVOPS-001
no PKI/identity material is defined here outside the SEC-owned contracts
reject_conditions: a device-identity / provisioning requirement accepted without a Security review reference when security_touchpoint = true (security baseline — ESC-SEC)
cryptographic device identity (keys/X.509) defined here instead of BACK↔SEC-001 / HW↔SEC-001
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real HW↔BACK §6 contract (or confirm the relationship is intentionally mediated via SEC/DEVOPS) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
ALWAYS escalate ESC-SEC when the coordination touches device identity — propose, do not auto-confirm; the Security Engineer owns the binding decision
